messages.subject: Executive candidate | Mining, energy, ESG and country leadership across Thailand and ASEAN
messages.body:
Dear Mr. John Gordon Holme, Mr. Alvin Nadal and Boyden Thailand Team,

I am reaching out because Boyden Thailand’s work across industrial, mining, energy, supply chain and multinational organizations aligns closely with the operating environments where I have built my career.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My 12+ years of experience span multinational mining, regulated financial services and commercial operations, with current responsibility across ESG, government and regulatory relations, corporate affairs, social performance, executive advisory and cross-functional delivery.

I offer a combination that is difficult to source in one profile: direct mining-sector credibility, senior government and regulator engagement, community and social-performance leadership, and practical energy-transition exposure. My recent work includes stakeholder and governance support around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage, together with carbon-data readiness and multi-agency regulatory coordination.

I am targeting Thailand, ASEAN and broader APAC mandates across Country Director, Country Representative, Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, ESG, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships and related industrial leadership roles. I am open to expatriate, regional and international assignments and have a 30-day notice period.

I have attached a Boyden-focused executive CV. I would value inclusion in relevant current or upcoming searches and a confidential discussion with the appropriate partner.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
